[h1]Minor Bug Fix[/h1]

We've released a minor update to [i]I'm Oh, So Busy...: A Week with Yoshimi[/i] today that fixes a glitch that stopped the achievement [i]A Teaspoon of Cinnamon[/i] from being unlocked.

Thank you to those of you who reported this bug to us! 

If you happen to spot something we've missed then please do let us know either on our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1367090/tradingforum/]Bug Report[/url] discussion in our Steam Community Hub, or on [url=https://discord.gg/EYXgTerefg]The Berry Guild Discord[/url] server!

-Dodo

notes.title: I'm Oh, So Busy... v1.1.4 OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39022839/de73ff1d12db5961bd652c95d742edd5ef9301ef.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone! 

Version 1.1.4 of I'm Oh, So Busy...: A Week with Yoshimi is now available! Changes in this new version include the following:

- Adjustments to the "Fade In/Fade Out" issues between screens and audio.
- Changes in music volume inconsistencies.
- Minor changes in audio positioning and errors with Yoshimi's lines.
- GUI adjustments with the "Let's Go!" button, changes to the text color on the Save/Load and notification screens.
- Fixed additional typos with the dialogue.
- Fixed issues with the Steam build where achievements would not appear.

If you happen to find any other issues with the game such as bugs, errors, or typos, please send me a message on Twitter (@berryischillin), shoot me an email (theberryguild@gmail.com), or hit me up here and I'll get on it as soon as I can. Thank you so, so much for your patience! 

-berry
